build.buildCommand: cd frontend && (npm ci --include=optional && npm run build || (echo 'RETRY: re-resolving platform native binaries' && rm -rf node_modules && npm install --include=optional && npm run build)) && cd ../backend && pip install -r requirements.txt

deploy.startCommand: cd backend && alembic upgrade head && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT
